chapter_seo_title: Desolate Era Ch. 295: Ji Ning Faces a Three-Hundred-Year-Old Monster for the Immortal Fortunes Assembly
chapter_meta_description: Ji Ning learns about the terrifying genius Daolord Muchuan, a South Sea monster who has been holding his cultivation at the Wanxiang stage for three centuries to compete in the Immortal Fortunes Assembly.
og_title: A Monster from the South Sea
og_description: Ji Ning gets his first real intel on the competition for the Immortal Fortunes Assembly, and the caliber of the opposition is terrifying.
twitter_title: Desolate Era Ch. 295: The Pre-Assembly Intel Drop
twitter_description: The hunt for the Shaoyan clan is on hold as Ji Ning learns about Daolord Muchuan—a genius who’s been grinding for 300 years just for one shot at the Immortal Fortunes Assembly.

lore_anchors.definition: A second body cultivated from a magical treasure or nascent soul, allowing a cultivator to exist in two places at once. They share a single soul and consciousness, but can cultivate different techniques simultaneously.

Periodic, unavoidable ordeals sent by the Heavenly Dao to test cultivators below the Celestial Immortal stage. Their power scales with the cultivator's strength, making it extremely dangerous to have a high-realm Primaltwin protecting a weak true body.
A grand tournament held by the Grand Xia Dynasty to discover and reward the most talented Wanxiang Adepts. The winners are often taken as disciples by the truly supreme powers of the Three Realms.

cultural_notes_faq.q: Why is Daolord Muchuan holding his true body at the Wanxiang stage for so long?
cultural_notes_faq.a: He is deliberately freezing his cultivation to participate in the Immortal Fortunes Assembly. If he wins, he can become the disciple of a Three Realms master, earning techniques that far surpass anything he could find on his own.

cultural_notes_faq.q: Isn't it suicidal to have a Wanxiang true body and an Earth Immortal Primaltwin?
cultural_notes_faq.a: Yes, it is an extremely high-risk strategy. The Heavenly Dao's tribulations scale to the strongest part of you. While Muchuan's Earth Immortal Primaltwin can withstand its own tribulations, those same calamities would also descend upon his weak true body, likely killing him.
